title: Supply of 1000 MW Round-the-Clock Thermal Mimic (RTC-TM) power from ISTS-connected RE projects
issuer: Solar Energy Corporation of India Limited (SECI)

documents.title: RfS (main tender document)
documents.note: Not uploaded. Its terms appear here only where an amendment, the clarifications or the PSA quote them.

documents.title: Amendment-01
documents.summary: Bid size down to 50 MW; DFR now per time-block only (90% peak, 70% off-peak), annual DFR penalty dropped; Peak Hours window 18:00 to 10:00; phased SCSD; new technical criteria; revised penalty illustration.

documents.title: Amendment-02
documents.summary: BESS co-located with RE; SCSD back to 24 months for the full capacity; EMD, PBG and net worth revised; discrete-component power priced by hour type; clause 34.3 marked 'Not used'.

documents.title: Clarifications-01
documents.summary: SECI's answers to bidders' queries: most requests refused ('Tender conditions remain unchanged'); DFR, Peak Hours and technical criteria referred to the amendments.

documents.title: Standard Power Sale Agreement (PSA)
documents.ref: PSA, SECI and the Buying Entity
documents.summary: The back-to-back sale from SECI to the Buying Entity: tariff plus 7 paise trading margin, DFR as first issued (before Amendment-01), offtake, excess power, compensation.

before.quote: a minimum quantum of cumulative Contracted Capacity of 100 MW and a maximum quantum of 500 MW

after.quote: a minimum quantum of cumulative Contracted Capacity of 50 MW and a maximum quantum of 500 MW

changes.effect: A bid may now be as small as 50 MW (was 100 MW); 500 MW stays the most.

before.quote: subject to the condition that the Scheduled Commissioning Date of the proposed new Delivery Point is on or before 30th June, 2028

after.quote: any change in Delivery Point from the one mentioned in the Covering Letter at the time of bid submission shall be allowed till the deadline to apply for connectivity.

changes.effect: The Delivery Point can change until the connectivity deadline, without the 30 June 2028 condition.

after.quote: The Bidder is required to provide the proof of SCD of substation in this regard at the time of bid submission, as part of Format-7.1 of the RfS.

changes.effect: The chosen ISTS substation must be scheduled for commissioning by 30 June 2028, with proof in Format-7.1.

before.quote: (ii) a minimum DFR of 80% in each time-block during the off-Peak Hours

after.quote: (i) a minimum DFR of 90% in each time-block during the Peak Hours; (ii) a minimum DFR of 70% in each time-block during the off-Peak Hours.

changes.effect: Off-peak floor down from 80% to 70% in every block; the 90% annual DFR is gone. Peak stays 90% in every block.

before.quote: (iii) averaging the DFR of all the time-blocks in a Contract Year, to measure the DFR compliance on annual basis.

after.quote: Penalty for both the above shortfalls will be calculated on time-block-wise basis and will be reconciled on monthly basis.

changes.effect: Only the block-wise peak and off-peak shortfalls are measured, monthly; no annual average.

before.quote: The Buying Entity shall choose any 6 hours on a daily basis between 00:00 Hrs. to 10:00 Hrs. and 18:00 Hrs. to 24:00 Hrs. of a day

after.quote: The Buying Entity shall choose any 6 hours, on a daily basis, between 18:00 Hrs. in the evening of a day and 10:00 Hrs. in the morning of the subsequent day

changes.effect: The six peak hours now come from one overnight window, 18:00 to 10:00 the next morning.

before.quote: the higher of the following two penalties shall be applicable: (i) the penalty for shortfall in the minimum annual DFR, or (ii) the aggregate penalty for shortfall in the minimum DFR requirements for Peak and Off-Peak Hours.

after.quote: In a particular Contract Year, the aggregate penalty for shortfall in the minimum DFR requirements for Peak and Off-Peak Hours shall be levied on the RPD.

changes.effect: Only the block-wise penalty applies.

before.quote: shall be the date as on 18 months from the Effective Date of the PPA

after.quote: (ii) Phase-II SCSD: The remaining RE generating component of the Project shall commence supply of power within 24 months from the Effective Date of the PPA.

changes.effect: Phased SCSD (ESS with its RE at 18 months, the rest at 24). Superseded by Amendment-02 (24 months for the full capacity).

after.quote: a single Generating Station/ Generating System/ Power Plant/ Power Project of Contracted Capacity not less than ‘4X/5’ MW in last seven years

changes.effect: Experience as Project Owner or EPC contractor: one plant ≥ 4X/5 MW, two ≥ X/2 MW, or three ≥ 2X/5 MW, in the last seven years. Amendment-02 then marks 34.3 'Not used'.

changes.topic: Part capacity to the last successful bidder

before.quote: is lower than 50% of the total quoted capacity by such Bidder or 100 MW

after.quote: is lower than 50% of the total quoted capacity by such Bidder or 50 MW

changes.effect: The threshold for the last bidder's part capacity follows the new 50 MW minimum.

after.quote: It is mandatory to use both domestically manufactured solar PV Cells and domestically manufactured solar PV modules.

changes.effect: Domestic cells and modules (ALMM List-I) for the solar component: a capex input to check.

before.quote: failure to maintain minimum annual DFR requirement as per Article 4.4.1 for a period of 2 (two) consecutive Contract Years

after.quote: failure to maintain minimum DFR requirement as per Article 4.4.1 in every time-block during Peak and Off-Peak Hours for a period of 2 (two) consecutive Contract Years

changes.effect: Missing the block floors for two consecutive Contract Years is an Event of Default (wording to confirm: read literally, any block).

after.quote: Penalty for the above month = (1.5 x 4.0 x 375 x 1000)/10000000= INR 22.50 Lakhs

changes.effect: The penalty is 1.5 x the tariff on the energy short of the block floors.

before.quote: For a single Project, the RE generation components, along with ESS, may either be co- located, or may be located at different locations.

after.quote: In case the Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) is utilized as the ESS component, the same shall be co-located with the RE generation component.

changes.effect: A battery must sit with RE generation (with at least one component on a multi-site project); only pumped hydro may stand alone.

after.quote: All charges and losses related to discharging the ESS component up to Delivery Point shall be borne by the RPD

changes.effect: Charges and losses up to the Delivery Point are the developer's.

before.quote: Phase-I SCSD: The Energy Storage System (ESS) component proposed to be installed as part of the Project, along with the corresponding co-located RE generating component shall commence supply of power within 18 months from the Effective Date of the PPA.

after.quote: The Scheduled Commencement of Supply Date (SCSD) for supplying power from the full Project capacity shall be the date as on 24 months from the Effective Date of the PPA

changes.effect: One SCSD for the full capacity, 24 months after the PPA's Effective Date.

after.quote: shall be limited to the date as on 6 months from the SCSD or the extended SCSD (if applicable)

changes.effect: Up to 6 months late with the PBG encashed pro rata; later than that is a default.

changes.topic: Power from a component ready early

before.quote: such power shall be purchased @ 50% of the PPA Tariff.

after.quote: (i) for power supplied during Peak Hours (as specified by the Buying Entity), @ PPA Tariff; (ii) for power supplied during non-solar hours, other than Peak Hours, @75% of the PPA Tariff; (iii) for power supplied during solar hours, other than Peak Hours, @50% of the PPA Tariff.

changes.effect: A component that starts before the rest sells at 100% (peak), 75% (non-solar) or 50% (solar hours) of the tariff.
EMD rises slightly; it depends on the installed solar, wind and storage, not the contracted MW.
PBG rises slightly, also on installed capacity.

after.quote: The Projects shall achieve Financial Closure by the date as on 6 months prior to the SCSD/ extended SCSD.

changes.effect: Financial Closure 6 months before the (single) SCSD: 18 months after the PPA.

after.quote: 12. 34.3 Not used.

changes.effect: Amendment-02 lists clause 34.3 as 'Not used'. Read with Clarifications-01 (queries 4 and 11 point to Amendment-02), the technical criterion appears withdrawn: confirm with SECI.

before.quote: (Rs. 95,40,000 x Rated cumulative Installed Capacity of Solar PV component (MW))

after.quote: Minimum Net-Worth requirement = [(Rs. 96,80,000 x Rated cumulative Installed Capacity of Solar PV component (MW)) + (Rs. 1,36,80,000 x Rated cumulative Installed Capacity of Wind Power component and other RE sources (MW)) + (Rs. 24,00,000 x Rated cumulative Installed Capacity of ESS component (MWh))]

changes.effect: The net worth needed rises slightly, on installed capacity.

clarifications.request: Raise green market sourcing from 5% to 15% of annual energy.

quote.quote: The RPD can source up to 5% RE power (in energy terms) on annual basis from green market sources/bilateral agreements.

clarifications.request: Fix Peak Hours monthly or for the term instead of day-ahead.

quote.quote: Peak Hours are to be declared by the Buying Entity on a day‑ahead basis

clarifications.request: EMD of Rs 10 lakh per contracted MW, capped at Rs 35 crore.

quote.quote: Bidder requests the EMD amount to be INR 10 Lakhs per MW of Bid Capacity (Contracted Capacity) with maximum Cap of INR 35 Crores.

clarifications.request: PBG of Rs 30 lakh per contracted MW.

quote.quote: Bidder requests the PBG amount to be INR 30 Lakhs per MW of Contracted Capacity

clarifications.request: 120 days instead of 60 after the Delivery Point is ready.

quote.quote: SCSD for such Projects shall be revised as the date as on 60 days subsequent to the readiness of the Delivery Point

clarifications.request: Widen the range from L1 + 2% to L1 + 5%.

quote.quote: The Bidders who fall within the range of (and including) the lowest tariff (L1 tariff) + 2% of the L1 tariff

clarifications.request: Let storage developers bid as lead with RE tie-ups.

quote.quote: Energy Storage Systems (ESS) shall mandatorily constitute part of the Project. It is clarified that ESS charged using a source other than RE power would not qualify as RE power.

clarifications.request: Is buying in the Green Day-Ahead Market to charge the BESS permitted?
clarifications.response: Kindly refer Clause 4.4.9 of the draft PPA (not provided).

quote.quote: It may please be clarified if procurement for GDAM market for charging of the BESS is permitted?

clarifications.response: Clause has been suitably modified. Kindly refer amendments-01.

quote.quote: These stringent DFR requirements, coupled with the inherently uncertain nature of renewable energy generation, expose developers to substantial penalties.

conditions.label: What is bought
conditions.value: 1000 MW of Round-the-Clock Thermal Mimic (RTC-TM) power from ISTS-connected RE projects

sources.quote: Supply of 1000 MW of Round-the- Clock Thermal Mimic (RTC-TM) Power from ISTS-connected Renewable Energy (RE) Power Projects in India

conditions.label: Contracted capacity per bidder
conditions.value: 50 MW to 500 MW (all group companies together, one bid)

sources.quote: a minimum quantum of cumulative Contracted Capacity of 50 MW and a maximum quantum of 500 MW

conditions.label: Who wins
conditions.value: Bidders within L1 + 2% of the lowest tariff are successful

sources.quote: The Bidders who fall within the range of (and including) the lowest tariff (L1 tariff) + 2% of the L1 tariff

conditions.label: Tariff
conditions.value: One tariff, fixed for the term, at the Delivery Point (the Buying Entity pays SECI 7 paise/kWh more)

sources.quote: fixed for entire term of agreement at delivery point and in addition thereto a trading margin of Seven (7) paisa/kWh shall be payable by the Buying Entity to SECI

conditions.label: Peak Hours floor
conditions.value: At least 90% of contracted capacity in every 15-minute block of the Peak Hours

sources.quote: (i) a minimum DFR of 90% in each time-block during the Peak Hours

conditions.label: Off-peak floor
conditions.value: At least 70% of contracted capacity in every 15-minute block outside the Peak Hours
conditions.was: 80%, relaxable to 70% for two monsoon months

sources.quote: (ii) a minimum DFR of 70% in each time-block during the off-Peak Hours.

conditions.label: Annual DFR
conditions.value: No annual floor: only the block-wise floors are measured

sources.quote: (iii) a minimum DFR of 90% on annual basis.
In a particular Contract Year, the aggregate penalty for shortfall in the minimum DFR requirements for Peak and Off-Peak Hours shall be levied on the RPD.

conditions.label: How a block's DFR is counted
conditions.value: Power scheduled ÷ contracted capacity, at most 1; 96 blocks of 15 minutes a day

sources.quote: DFR = [Power Injection Scheduled by the RPD (MW) in a particular time block ÷ Contracted Capacity (MW)], subject to the maximum value of DFR being 1.
a day shall consist of 96 time-blocks (each block comprising a 15 minutes’ duration)

conditions.label: Peak Hours
conditions.value: Any 6 hours a day, chosen day-ahead by the Buying Entity, between 18:00 and 10:00 the next morning

sources.quote: The Buying Entity shall choose any 6 hours, on a daily basis, between 18:00 Hrs. in the evening of a day and 10:00 Hrs. in the morning of the subsequent day
These 6 hours shall be intimated by the Buying Entity on day-ahead basis

conditions.label: Shortfall penalty
conditions.value: 1.5 × the tariff on the energy short of each block's floor, settled monthly

sources.quote: Penalty for the above month = (1.5 x 4.0 x 375 x 1000)/10000000= INR 22.50 Lakhs
Penalty for both the above shortfalls will be calculated on time-block-wise basis and will be reconciled on monthly basis.

conditions.label: Event of Default
conditions.value: Failing the block floors for two consecutive Contract Years (not counting the first, short one)
conditions.flag: The literal wording ('in every time-block') would make a single missed block in two years a default: worth a pre-bid query.

sources.quote: failure to maintain minimum DFR requirement as per Article 4.4.1 in every time-block during Peak and Off-Peak Hours for a period of 2 (two) consecutive Contract Years

conditions.label: Offtake
conditions.value: The Buying Entity must take all power scheduled up to the contracted capacity; you schedule day-ahead

sources.quote: The Buying Entity shall compulsorily offtake all the power, subject to the maximum power scheduled in any time-block being equal to the Contracted Capacity.

conditions.label: Power above the contracted capacity
conditions.value: Free to sell to any third party or power exchange, no NOC needed

sources.quote: the SECI/RPD is free to sell power in excess of the Contracted Capacity in any time-block, to any third party or power exchange, without requiring any NOC from Buying Entity.

conditions.label: Green market sourcing
conditions.value: Up to 5% of annual energy from green market or bilateral sources (not modelled)

sources.quote: The RPD can source up to 5% RE power (in energy terms) on annual basis from green market sources/bilateral agreements.

conditions.label: Storage
conditions.value: Storage is mandatory and must charge from RE only

sources.quote: Energy Storage Systems (ESS) shall mandatorily constitute part of the Project. It is clarified that ESS charged using a source other than RE power would not qualify as RE power.

conditions.label: Battery location
conditions.value: A battery is co-located with RE generation (on a multi-site project, with at least one RE component)

sources.quote: In case the Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) is utilized as the ESS component, the same shall be co-located with the RE generation component.

conditions.label: Solar modules
conditions.value: Domestic cells and domestic modules, ALMM List-I

sources.quote: It is mandatory to use both domestically manufactured solar PV Cells and domestically manufactured solar PV modules.

conditions.label: Charges and losses
conditions.value: Up to the Delivery Point: yours; beyond it: the Buying Entity's

sources.quote: All charges and losses related to discharging the ESS component up to Delivery Point shall be borne by the RPD

conditions.label: Delivery Point substation
conditions.value: One of the four substation choices of cl. 7.5, scheduled to commission by 30 June 2028 (proof in Format-7.1)

sources.quote: The Bidder is required to provide the proof of SCD of substation in this regard at the time of bid submission, as part of Format-7.1 of the RfS.

conditions.label: Supply starts (SCSD)
conditions.value: 24 months after the PPA's Effective Date, for the full capacity
conditions.was: Phased by Amendment-01: storage at 18 months, the rest at 24

sources.quote: The Scheduled Commencement of Supply Date (SCSD) for supplying power from the full Project capacity shall be the date as on 24 months from the Effective Date of the PPA

conditions.label: Latest start with penalty
conditions.value: 6 months after the SCSD; the PBG is encashed pro rata for capacity not supplying

sources.quote: shall be limited to the date as on 6 months from the SCSD or the extended SCSD (if applicable)

conditions.label: Financial Closure
conditions.value: 6 months before the SCSD

sources.quote: The Projects shall achieve Financial Closure by the date as on 6 months prior to the SCSD/ extended SCSD.
